build.funnel: earnings top-K opened to every gated name (no truncation)

pit_status.earnings: PIT_VERIFIED — deterministic; _window cuts quarters to date+provider-lag < as_of (evidence/phase4_pit_probes.txt)
pit_status.quality: PIT_VERIFIED — deterministic; facts cut by public availability (filing) date, boundary probe passed
pit_status.meds: PIT_APPROXIMATE — deterministic, as-of floored, PIT lags applied, but series are fetched at TODAY's vintage (pit_mode=approximate_pit_lag) — pit_verified false

price_field: Yahoo daily ADJUSTED close (earnings_engine.prices, auto_adjust=True); feature prices are cut at as-of by the engines, label prices are strictly after as-of
embargo: Labels look up to 63 trading days (~3 calendar months) ahead of their as-of date. With monthly as-of dates, consecutive dates' label windows overlap by construction: walk-forward training must purge + embargo at least 63 trading days (3 monthly periods; 1 quarterly period) between train and test, and rows must be grouped by `group` (never shuffled across time).

targets.y_q: 1 if the 63-trading-day forward return beats SPY (quality is slow)
targets.y_e: 1 if the 30-trading-day return after the next earnings event (first event strictly after as-of, within 63 td) beats SPY; NaN when no event or incomplete prices
targets.y_m: 1 if the sector ETF beats SPY over the next calendar month

survivorship_warning: The universe is TODAY's active listing set (quality's builtin universe, active refs only): names delisted before the build are absent by construction and forward returns are upward-biased. Results exclude costs and claim no alpha.

data_provenance.note: built by REAL engine runs (phase-5 evidence: evidence/phase5_real_run.txt, REAL-DERIVED harvests); the field is the v1.8.0 provenance migration — additive metadata, the dataset npz is untouched
